mapper.select: SELECT A.ATTNAME FROM PG_CATALOG.PG_INDEX I INNER JOIN PG_CATALOG.PG_CLASS T ON I.INDRELID = T.OID INNER JOIN PG_CATALOG.PG_NAMESPACE N ON T.RELNAMESPACE = N.OID CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(I.INDKEY) WITH ORDINALITY AS K(ATTNUM, KEY_ORDER) INNER JOIN PG_CATALOG.PG_ATTRIBUTE A ON A.ATTRELID = T.OID AND A.ATTNUM = K.ATTNUM WHERE N.NSPNAME = #{schema} AND T.RELNAME = #{table} AND I.INDISPRIMARY AND K.KEY_ORDER <= I.INDNKEYATTS ORDER BY K.KEY_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE ( ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID, RAW_DATA_ID, TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID, STATUS, ATTEMPT_COUNT, LOADED_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) SELECT #{analysisModelVersionId}, T.RAW_DATA_ID, R.TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID, 'PENDING', 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_RESULT R INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_TASK T ON R.TRANSFORM_TASK_ID = T.TRANSFORM_TASK_ID WHERE R.TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID = #{transformResultId} AND T.TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID = #{transformRuleVersionId} AND T.STATUS = 'SUCCESS'
mapper.select: UPDATE SCHED_ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE SET STATUS = 'RUNNING', ATTEMPT_COUNT = ATTEMPT_COUNT + 1, STARTED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FINISHED_AT = NULL, ERROR_MESSAGE = NULL, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE_ID IN ( SELECT ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE_ID FROM SCHED_ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CREATED_AT, ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE_ID LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE_ID, ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID, TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID, STATUS

SELECT L.ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE_ID, V.ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID, L.ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID, L.TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID, L.STATUS, M.TARGET_SCHEMA, M.TARGET_TABLE, CAST(R.RESULT_DATA AS TEXT) AS RESULT_DATA FROM SCHED_ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE L INNER JOIN SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION V ON L.ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID = V.ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID INNER JOIN SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL M ON V.ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID = M.ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_RESULT R ON L.TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID = R.TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_TASK T ON R.TRANSFORM_TASK_ID = T.TRANSFORM_TASK_ID AND T.TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID = V.TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID AND T.RAW_DATA_ID = L.RAW_DATA_ID AND T.STATUS = 'SUCCESS' WHERE L.ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE_ID = #{analysisLoadSourceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SCHED_ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE SET STATUS = 'SUCCESS', LOADED_COUNT = #{loadedCount}, FINISHED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ERROR_MESSAGE = NULL, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE_ID = #{analysisLoadSourceId} AND STATUS = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE SCHED_ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE SET STATUS = 'FAILED', LOADED_COUNT = 0, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FINISHED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ANALYSIS_LOAD_SOURCE_ID = #{analysisLoadSourceId} AND STATUS = 'RUNNING'
